title: Excel Column Title Conversion

content.problemStatement:
Given a positive integer N, convert it into the corresponding Excel column title.

Rules:

1 → A

2 → B

…

26 → Z

27 → AA

28 → AB

52 → AZ

53 → BA

and so on…

This behaves like base-26, but with letters A–Z representing 1–26.

| Input | Output |
| ----- | ------ |
| 1     | A      |
| 26    | Z      |
| 27    | AA     |
| 28    | AB     |
| 37    | AK     |
| 38    | AL     |
